scope: Alpha development, Alpha reserved validation and Unlimited set transfer. Header costs only, unchanged title fitting and body. Retain existing frame, SVG and font assets. One shared cost geometry; no per-scan registration.

registration.note: Retain shared identity from early-frame-review.json. Alpha outer-frame ambiguity remains; these are component diagnostics.

reservation: Selection uses names and mana metadata, not image scores. No reserved mana crops are opened or measured until the candidate is committed. Earlier whole-set captures do not certify these fields.

gate: Correct printed symbols and disc presence, same inputs and unrelated pixels; positive median row F1 gain at both tiers in each set, at least 90% nonregressing within .02, and direct review of every reserved crop. Any larger regression needs an identified asset/source/measurement issue supported by visible evidence. Failed geometry transfer remains rejected, without tuning reserved cards.
candidateDesign: Inspect development costs first, then bound a grid of common rightmost center, vertical center and pitch. Test the existing original sun glyph and retained SVGs without shadows. Fixed nominal region windows are declared before measurement.
